Resolves #21966

The vertical line on a folder's toggle was drawn 1px right of the lane its children draw at the same depth. `.neo-tree-toggle` centered its 1px line with `background-position: center`, which lands at `(24px - 1px) / 2 = 11.5px` and snaps to `12px`, while `.neo-tree-indent` paints its lane at `calc(var(--tree-toggle-width, 24px) / 2 - 1px)` = `11px`. The toggle now uses that same `calc()`, and its width reads `--tree-toggle-width` instead of a fixed `24px`, so both elements follow one value. No public API change; the only visual change is the 1px shift of the toggle's line.

Evidence: L2 (new e2e assertion in `test/playwright/e2e/grid/Tree.spec.mjs`, fails on `dev` and passes with the fix) -> L3 required (ACs ask for visual before/after).

## AC Evidence
| AC | Proof |
|---|---|
| AC-1 toggle stem at `calc(var(--tree-toggle-width, 24px) / 2 - 1px) 0` | `resources/css/src/grid/column/Tree.css`; new spec: without the fix `Expected: 38, Received: 38.5`, with it passes |
| AC-2 toggle width reads `--tree-toggle-width` | `resources/css/src/grid/column/component/Tree.css`; spec sets `--tree-toggle-width: 30px` and checks the toggle is 30px wide and still aligned |
| AC-3 leaf connectors flush | `.is-leaf::after` starts at `left: 50%` = 12px, the right edge of the 11px..12px stem, so it still meets the line |
| AC-4 Playwright coverage | `npm run test-e2e -- test/playwright/e2e/grid/Tree.spec.mjs` |
| AC-5 before/after screenshots | Zoomed before (`dev`) / after screenshots of `examples/grid/treeBigData` follow in a comment |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive. The spec compares the folder's stem against the lane its child row draws at that depth, at the default width and under a 30px `--tree-toggle-width` override.
